name: ClickFunnels Email Broadcast CRUD API
description:
CRUD endpoints for email broadcasts in ClickFunnels API V2.

**Feature Gates:**
- `email-sending-api` - Required for all endpoints
- `can-see-analytics-in-broadcasts-payloads` - Required for progress/performance/revenue attributes

**URL Structure:**
- Collection endpoints use workspace scope: `/workspaces/:id/emails/broadcasts`
- Individual resource endpoints use broadcast ID only: `/emails/broadcasts/:id`
